verses.en: A man's belly shall be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth; and with the increase of his lips shall he be filled.
verses.am: የሰው ሆድ ከአፉ ፍሬ ይሞላል ከንፈሩም ከሚያፈራው ይጠግባል።

verses.en: Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.
verses.am: ሞትና ሕይወት በምላስ እጅ ናቸው፤ የሚወድዱአትም ፍሬዋን ይበላሉ።

verses.en: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing, and obtaineth favour of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ሚስት ያገኘ በረከትን አገኘ፥ ከእግዚአብሔርም ሞገስን ይቀበላል።

verses.en: The poor useth intreaties; but the rich answereth roughly.
verses.am: ድሀ በትሕትና እየለመነ ይናገራል፤ ባለጠጋ ግን በድፍረት ይመልሳል።

verses.en: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.
verses.am: ብዙ ወዳጆች ያሉት ሰው ይጠፋል፤ ነገር ግን ከወንድም አብልጦ የሚጠጋጋ ወዳጅ አለ።

verses.en: Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity, than he that is perverse in his lips, and is a fool.
verses.am: በከንፈሩ ከሚወሳልት ሰነፍ ይልቅ ያለ ነውር የሚሄድ ድሀ ይሻላል።

verses.en: Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is not good; and he that hasteth with his feet sinneth.
verses.am: ነፍስ እውቀት የሌለባት ትሆን ዘንድ መልካም አይደለም፤ እግሩንም የሚያፈጥን ከመንገድ ይስታል።

verses.en: The foolishness of man perverteth his way: and his heart fretteth against YAHUAH.
verses.am: የሰው ስንፍና መንገዱን ታጣምምበታለች፤ ልቡም በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ይቈጣል።

verses.en: Wealth maketh many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbour.
verses.am: ባለጠግነት ብዙ ወዳጆች ይጨምራል፤ የድሀ ወዳጅ ግን ከእርሱ ይርቃል።

verses.en: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall not escape.
verses.am: ሐሰተኛ ምስክር ሳይቀጣ አይቀርም፥ በሐሰትም የሚናገር አያመልጥም።

verses.en: Many will intreat the favour of the prince: and every man is a friend to him that giveth gifts.
verses.am: ብዙ ሰዎች ለጋሱን ያቈላምጣሉ፥ ስጦታ ለሚሰጥም ሁሉ ወዳጅ ነው።

verses.en: All the brethren of the poor do hate him: how much more do his friends go far from him? he pursueth them with words, yet they are wanting to him.
verses.am: ድሀን ሰው ወንድሞቹ ሁሉ ይጠሉታል፤ ይልቁንም ወዳጆቹ ከእርሱ ይርቃሉ። እነርሱንም በቃል ቢከተላቸው አንዳች አይረቡትም።

verses.en: He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul: he that keepeth understanding shall find good.
verses.am: ጥበብን የሚያገኝ ነፍሱን ይወድዳል፥ ማስተዋልንም የሚጠብቅ መልካም ነገርን ያገኛል።

verses.en: A false witness shall not be unpunished, and he that speaketh lies shall perish.
verses.am: ሐሰተኛ ምስክር ሳይቀጣ አይቀርም፤ በሐሰትም የሚናገር ይጠፋል።

verses.en: Delight is not seemly for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.
verses.am: ለሰነፍ ቅምጥልነት አይገባውም፥ ይልቁንም ባሪያ በአለቆች ላይ ይገዛ ዘንድ።

verses.en: The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.
verses.am: ሰውን ጠቢብ አእምሮው ከቍጣ ያዘገየዋል፥ ለበደለኛውም ይቅር ይል ዘንድ ክብር ይሆንለታል።

verses.en: The king's wrath is as the roaring of a lion; but his favour is as dew upon the grass.
verses.am: እንደ አንበሳ ግሣት የንጉሥ ቍጣ ነው፥ ሞገሱም በመስክ ላይ እንዳለ ጠል ነው።

verses.en: A foolish son is the calamity of his father: and the contentions of a wife are a continual dropping.
verses.am: ሰነፍ ልጅ ለአባቱ ኀዘን ነው፥ ጠበኛም ሚስት እንደማያቋርጥ ነጠብጣብ ናት።

verses.en: House and riches are the inheritance of fathers: and a prudent wife is from YAHUAH.
verses.am: ቤትና ባለጠግነት ከአባቶች ዘንድ ይወረሳሉ፤ አስተዋይ ሚስት ግን ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ናት።

verses.en: Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger.
verses.am: ተግባር መፍታት እንቅልፍን ታመጣለች፥ የታካችም ነፍስ ትራባለች።

verses.en: He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul; but he that despiseth his ways shall die.
verses.am: ትእዛዝን የሚጠብቅ ነፍሱን ይጠብቃል፤ መንገዱን ቸል የሚል ግን ይጠፋል።

verses.en: He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto YAHUAH; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.
verses.am: ለድሀ ቸርነትን የሚያደርግ ለእግዚአብሔር ያበድራል፥ በጎነቱንም መልሶ ይከፍለዋል።

verses.en: Chasten thy son while there is hope, and let not thy soul spare for his crying.
verses.am: ተስፋ ገና ሳለች ልጅህን ገሥጽ፥ መሞቱንም አትሻ።

verses.en: A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment: for if thou deliver him, yet thou must do it again.
verses.am: ንዴተኛ ሰው መቀጮ ይከፍላል፤ ብታድነውም ደግሞ ትጨምራለህ።

verses.en: Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.
verses.am: ምክርን ስማ፥ ተግሣጽንም ተቀበል በፍጻሜህ ጠቢብ ትሆን ዘንድ።

verses.en: There are many devices in a man's heart; nevertheless the counsel of YAHUAH, that shall stand.
verses.am: በሰው ልብ ብዙ አሳብ አለ፤ የእግዚአብሔር ምክር ግን እርሱ ይጸናል።

verses.en: The desire of a man is his kindness: and a poor man is better than a liar.
verses.am: የሰው ቸርነት የእርሱ ፍሬ ነው፤ ከሐሰተኛ ባለጠጋም እውነተኛ ድሀ ይሻላል።

verses.en: The fear of YAHUAH tendeth to life: and he that hath it shall abide satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት ወደ ሕይወት ይመራል፤ የሚፈራውም ጠግቦ ይኖራል፥ ክፉ ነገርም አያገኘውም።

verses.en: A slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom, and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
verses.am: ታካች ሰው እጁን በወጭቱ ያጠልቃታል፥ ወደ አፉ ስንኳ አይመልሳትም።

verses.en: Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware: and reprove one that hath understanding, and he will understand knowledge.
verses.am: ፌዘኛ ብትገርፈው አላዋቂ ብልሃተኛ ይሆናል፤ አስተዋይን ሰው ብትገሥጸው እውቀትን ያገኛል።

verses.en: He that wasteth his father, and chaseth away his mother, is a son that causeth shame, and bringeth reproach.
verses.am: አባቱን የሚያስከፋ እናቱንም የሚያሳድድ የሚያሳፍርና ጐስቋላ ልጅ ነው።

verses.en: Cease, my son, to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge.
verses.am: ልጅ ሆይ፥ ተግሣጽን ከሰማህ በኋላ ከእውቀት ቃል መሳሳትን ተው።

verses.en: An ungodly witness scorneth judgment: and the mouth of the wicked devoureth iniquity.
verses.am: ወስላታ ምስክር በፍርድ ያፌዛል፥ የኀጥኣንም አፍ ክፋትን ይውጣል።

verses.en: Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of fools.
verses.am: ለሚያፌዙ ሰዎች ፍርድ ተዘጋጅታለች፥ ለሰነፎችም ጀርባ በትር።

verses.en: Wine is a mocker, strong drink is raging: and whosoever is deceived thereby is not wise.
verses.am: የወይን ጠጅ ፌዘኛ ያደርጋል፥ ብርቱ መጠጥም ጠበኛ ያደርጋል፤ በዚህም የሳተ ሁሉ ጠቢብ አይደለም።

verses.en: The fear of a king is as the roaring of a lion: whoso provoketh him to anger sinneth against his own soul.
verses.am: የንጉሥ ቍጣ እንደ አንበሳ ግሣት ነው፤ የሚያስቈጣውም ሰው የራሱን ነፍስ ይበድላል።

verses.en: It is an honour for a man to cease from strife: but every fool will be meddling.
verses.am: ከክርክር ይርቅ ዘንድ ለሰው ክብሩ ነው፤ ሰነፍ ሁሉ ግን እንዲህ ባለ ነገር ይጣመራል።

verses.en: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold; therefore shall he beg in harvest, and have nothing.
verses.am: ታካች ሰው በብርድ ምክንያት አያርስም፤ ስለዚህ በመከር ይለምናል፥ ምንም አያገኝም።

verses.en: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water; but a man of understanding will draw it out.
verses.am: ምክር በሰው ልብ እንደ ጠሊቅ ውኃ ነው፤ አእምሮ ያለው ሰው ግን ይቀዳዋል።

verses.en: Most men will proclaim every one his own goodness: but a faithful man who can find?
verses.am: ብዙ ሰዎች ቸርነታቸውን ያወራሉ፤ የታመነውን ሰው ግን ማን ያገኘዋል?

verses.en: The just man walketh in his integrity: his children are blessed after him.
verses.am: ጻድቅ ያለ ነውር ይሄዳል፥ ልጆቹም ከእርሱ በኋላ ምስጉኖች ናቸው።

verses.en: A king that sitteth in the throne of judgment scattereth away all evil with his eyes.
verses.am: በፍርድ ወንበር የተቀመጠ ንጉሥ ክፉውን ሁሉ በዓይኖቹ ይበትናል።

verses.en: Who can say, I have made my heart clean, I am pure from my sin?
verses.am: ልቤን አነጻሁ፥ ከኃጢአትም ጠራሁ የሚል ማን ነው?

verses.en: Divers weights, and divers measures, both of them are alike abomination to YAHUAH.
verses.am: ሁለት ዓይነት ሚዛንና ሁለት ዓይነት መስፈሪያ፥ ሁለቱ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ርኩሳን ናቸው።

verses.en: Even a child is known by his doings, whether his work be pure, and whether it be right.
verses.am: ሕፃን ቅንና ንጹሕ መሆኑ በሚያደርገው ሥራ ይታወቃል።

verses.en: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, YAHUAH hath made even both of them.
verses.am: የሚሰማ ጆሮንና የሚያይ ዓይንን፥ ሁለቱን እግዚአብሔር ፈጠራቸው።

verses.en: Love not sleep, lest thou come to poverty; open thine eyes, and thou shalt be satisfied with bread.
verses.am: ድሀ እንዳትሆን እንቅልፍን አትውደድ፤ ዓይንህን ክፈት፥ እንጀራም ትጠግባለህ።

verses.en: It is naught, it is naught, saith the buyer: but when he is gone his way, then he boasteth.
verses.am: የሚገዛ ሰው። ክፉ ነው ክፉ ነው ይላል፤ በሄደ ጊዜ ግን ይመካል።

verses.en: There is gold, and a multitude of rubies: but the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel.
verses.am: ወርቅና ብዙ ቀይ ዕንቍ ይገኛል፤ የእውቀት ከንፈር ግን የከበረች ጌጥ ናት።

verses.en: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger: and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.
verses.am: ለማያውቀው ከተዋሰ ሰው ልብሱን ውሰድ፥ ለእንግዳ የተዋሰውንም እርሱን አግተው።

verses.en: Bread of deceit is sweet to a man; but afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel.
verses.am: የሐሰት እንጀራ ለሰው የጣፈጠ ነው፤ ከዚያ በኋላ ግን አፉ ጭንጫ ይሞላል።

verses.en: Every purpose is established by counsel: and with good advice make war.
verses.am: አሳብ በምክር ትጸናለች፥ በመልካምም ምክር ሰልፍ አድርግ።

verses.en: He that goeth about as a talebearer revealeth secrets: therefore meddle not with him that flattereth with his lips.
verses.am: ዘዋሪ ሐሜተኛ ምሥጢርን ይገልጣል፤ ከንፈሩን የሚያሞጠሙጥ ሰውን አትገናኘው።

verses.en: Whoso curseth his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in obscure darkness.
verses.am: አባቱን ወይም እናቱን የሚሰድብ፥ በጽቅድቅ ጨለማ መብራቱ ይጠፋል።

verses.en: An inheritance may be gotten hastily at the beginning; but the end thereof shall not be blessed.
verses.am: በመጀመሪያ ፈጥኖ የተከማቸ ርስት ፍጻሜው አይባረክም።

verses.en: Say not thou, I will recompense evil; but wait on YAHUAH, and he shall save thee.
verses.am: ክፉ እመልሳለሁ አትበል፤ እግዚአብሔርን ተማመን፥ እርሱም ያድንሃል።

verses.en: Divers weights are an abomination unto YAHUAH; and a false balance is not good.
verses.am: ሁለት ዓይነት ሚዛን በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ አስጸያፊ ነው፥ ሐሰተኛ ሚዛንም መልካም አይደለም።

verses.en: Man's goings are of YAHUAH; how can a man then understand his own way?
verses.am: የሰው አካሄዱ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነው፤ እንግዲያስ ሰው መንገዱን እንዴት ያስተውላል?

verses.en: It is a snare to the man who devoureth that which is holy, and after vows to make enquiry.
verses.am: ሰው በችኰላ። ለእግዚአብሔር የተቀደሰ ነው ብሎ ቢሳል፥ ከተሳለም በኋላ ቢፀፀት ወጥመድ ነው።

verses.en: A wise king scattereth the wicked, and bringeth the wheel over them.
verses.am: ጠቢብ ንጉሥ ኀጥኣንን በመንሽ ይበትናቸዋል፥ መንኰራኵሩንም በእነርሱ ላይ ያንኰራኵርባቸዋል።

verses.en: The spirit of man is the candle of YAHUAH, searching all the inward parts of the belly.
verses.am: የሰው መንፈስ የእግዚአብሔር መብራት ነው የሆዱን ጕርጆች ሁሉ የሚመረምር።

verses.en: Mercy and truth preserve the king: and his throne is upholden by mercy.
verses.am: ቸርነትና እውነት ንጉሥን ይጠብቁታል፤ ዙፋኑም በቸርነት ይበረታል።

verses.en: The glory of young men is their strength: and the beauty of old men is the gray head.
verses.am: የጎበዛዝት ክብር ጕልበታቸው ናት፥ የሽማግሌዎችም ጌጥ ሽበት ነው።

verses.en: The blueness of a wound cleanseth away evil: so do stripes the inward parts of the belly.
verses.am: የሰንበር ቍስል ክፉዎችን ያነጻል፤ ግርፋትም ወደ ሆድ ጕርጆች ይገባል።

verses.en: The king's heart is in the hand of YAHUAH, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.
verses.am: የንጉሥ ልብ እንደ ውኃ ፈሳሾች በእግዚአብሔር እጅ ነው፤ ወደ ወደደውም ያዘነብለዋል።

verses.en: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes: but YAHUAH pondereth the hearts.
verses.am: የሰው መንገድ ሁሉ በዓይኑ ፊት የቀናች ትመስለዋለች፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን ልብን ይመዝናል።

verses.en: To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to YAHUAH than sacrifice.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ከመሥዋዕት ይልቅ ጽድቅንና ቅን ነገርን ማድረግ ይወድዳል።

verses.en: An high look, and a proud heart, and the plowing of the wicked, is sin.
verses.am: ትዕቢተኛ ዓይንና ደፋር ልብ የኀጥኣንም እርሻ ኃጢአት ነው።

verses.en: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness; but of every one that is hasty only to want.
verses.am: የትጉህ አሳብ ወደ ጥጋብ ያደርሳል፤ ችኵል ሰው ሁሉ ግን ለመጕደል ይቸኩላል።

verses.en: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death.
verses.am: በሐሰተኛ ምላስ መዝገብ ማከማቸት የሚበንን ጉም ነው፤ ይህን የሚፈልጉ ሞትን ይፈልጋሉ።

verses.en: The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them; because they refuse to do judgment.
verses.am: ቅን ነገርን ያደርጉ ዘንድ አይወድዱምና የኀጥኣን ንጥቂያ ራሳቸውን ያጠፋቸዋል።

verses.en: The way of man is froward and strange: but as for the pure, his work is right.
verses.am: የበደለኛ መንገድ የጠመመች ናት፤ የንጹሕ ሥራ ግን የቀና ነው።

verses.en: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman in a wide house.
verses.am: ከጠበኛ ሴት ጋር በአንድ ቤት ከመቀመጥ በውጪ በቤት ማዕዘን ላይ መቀመጥ ይሻላል።

verses.en: The soul of the wicked desireth evil: his neighbour findeth no favour in his eyes.
verses.am: የኀጥእ ነፍስ ክፉን ትመኛለች፥ በፊቱም ባልንጀራው ሞገስን አያገኝም።

verses.en: When the scorner is punished, the simple is made wise: and when the wise is instructed, he receiveth knowledge.
verses.am: ፌዘኛ ቅጣትን በተቀበለ ጊዜ አላዋቂ ሰው ጥበብን ያገኛል፤ ጠቢብም ቢማር እውቀትን ይቀበላል።

verses.en: The righteous man wisely considereth the house of the wicked: but YAHUAH overthroweth the wicked for their wickedness.
verses.am: ጻድቅ ስለ ኀጥእ ቤት ያስባል፥ ኀጥኣንም ለጥፋት እንደ ተገለበጡ።

verses.en: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, he also shall cry himself, but shall not be heard.
verses.am: የድሀውን ጩኸት እንዳይሰማ ጆሮውን የሚደፍን ሰው፥ እርሱ ራሱ ይጮኻል አይሰማለትምም።

verses.en: A gift in secret pacifieth anger: and a reward in the bosom strong wrath.
verses.am: ስጦታ በስውር ቍጣን ታጠፋለች፥ የብብትም ውስጥ ጉቦ ጽኑ ቍጣን ታበርዳለች።

verses.en: It is joy to the just to do judgment: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.
verses.am: ፍርድን ማድረግ ለጻድቅ ደስታ ነው፤ ኃጢአትን ለሚያደርጉ ግን ጥፋት ነው።

verses.en: The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead.
verses.am: ከማስተዋል መንገድ የሚሳሳት ሰው በሙታን ጉባኤ ያርፋል።

verses.en: He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man: he that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich.
verses.am: ተድላ የሚወድድ ድሀ ይሆናል፥ የወይን ጠጅንና ዘይትንም የሚወድድ ባለጠጋ አይሆንም።

verses.en: The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous, and the transgressor for the upright.
verses.am: ኀጥእ የጻድቅ ቤዛ ነው፤ በደለኛም የቅን ሰው ቤዛ ነው።

verses.en: It is better to dwell in the wilderness, than with a contentious and an angry woman.
verses.am: ከጠበኛና ከቍጡ ሴት ጋር ከመቀመጥ በምድረ በዳ መቀመጥ ይሻላል።

verses.en: There is treasure to be desired and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man spendeth it up.
verses.am: የከበረ መዝገብና ዘይት በጠቢብ ሰው ቤት ይኖራል። አእምሮ የሌለው ሰው ግን ይውጠዋል።

verses.en: He that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life, righteousness, and honour.
verses.am: ጽድቅንና ምሕረትን የሚከተል ሕይወትንና ጽድቅን ክብርንም ያገኛል።

verses.en: A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty, and casteth down the strength of the confidence thereof.
verses.am: ጠቢብ የኃያላንን ከተማ ይገባባታል፥ የሚታመኑበትንም ኃይል ያፈርሳል።

verses.en: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue keepeth his soul from troubles.
verses.am: አፉንና ምላሱን የሚጠብቅ ነፍሱን ከመከራ ይጠብቃል።

verses.en: Proud and haughty scorner is his name, who dealeth in proud wrath.
verses.am: ኵሩና ተጓዳጅ ሰው ፌዘኛ ይባላል፤ እርሱም በትዕቢት ቍጣ ያደርጋል።

verses.en: The desire of the slothful killeth him; for his hands refuse to labour.
verses.am: ታካችን ምኞቱ ትገድለዋለች፥ እጆቹ ይሠሩ ዘንድ አይፈቅዱምና።

verses.en: He coveteth greedily all the day long: but the righteous giveth and spareth not.
verses.am: ኀጥእ ቀኑን ሁሉ ምኞትን ይመኛል፤ ጻድቅ ግን ይሰጣል፥ አይሰስትም።

verses.en: The sacrifice of the wicked is abomination: how much more, when he bringeth it with a wicked mind?
verses.am: የኀጥኣን መሥዋዕት አስጸያፊ ነው፤ ይልቁንም በክፉ አሳብ ሲያቀርቡት አስጸያፊ ነው።

verses.en: A false witness shall perish: but the man that heareth speaketh constantly.
verses.am: ሐሰተኛ ምስክር ይጠፋል፤ የሚሰማ ሰው ግን ተጠንቅቆ ይናገራል።

verses.en: A wicked man hardeneth his face: but as for the upright, he directeth his way.
verses.am: ኀጥእ ፊቱን ያጠነክራል፤ ቅን ሰው ግን መንገዱን ያጸናል።

verses.en: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against YAHUAH.
verses.am: ጥበብ ወይም ማስተዋል ወይም ምክር በእግዚአብሔር ላይ የለም።

verses.en: The horse is prepared against the day of battle: but safety is of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ፈረስ ለጦርነት ቀን ይዘጋጃል፤ ድል ግን ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነው።

verses.en: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving favour rather than silver and gold.
verses.am: መልካም ስም ከብዙ ባለጠግነት ይሻላል፥ መልካምም ሞገስ ከብርና ከወርቅ ይበልጣል።

verses.en: The rich and poor meet together: YAHUAH is the maker of them all.
verses.am: ባለጠና ድሀ ተገናኙ፤ እግዚአብሔር የሁላቸው ፈጣሪ ነው።

verses.en: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself: but the simple pass on, and are punished.
verses.am: ብልህ ሰው ክፉን አይቶ ይሸሸጋል፤ አላዋቂዎች ግን አልፈው ይጐዳሉ።

verses.en: By humility and the fear of YAHUAH are riches, and honour, and life.
verses.am: ትሕትናና እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት ባለጠግነት ክብር ሕይወትም ነው።

verses.en: Thorns and snares are in the way of the froward: he that doth keep his soul shall be far from them.
verses.am: እሾህና ወጥመድ በጠማማ ሰው መንገድ ናቸው፤ ነፍሱን ግን የሚጠብቅ ከእነርሱ ይርቃል።

verses.en: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.
verses.am: ልጅን በሚሄድበት መንገድ ምራው፥ በሸመገለም ጊዜ ከእርሱ ፈቀቅ አይልም።

verses.en: The rich ruleth over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.
verses.am: ባለጠጋ ድሆችን ይገዛል፥ ተበዳሪም የአበዳሪ ባሪያ ነው።

verses.en: He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity: and the rod of his anger shall fail.
verses.am: ኃጢአትን የሚዘራ መከራን ያጭዳል፥ የቍጣውም በትር ይጠፋል።

verses.en: He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed; for he giveth of his bread to the poor.
verses.am: ርኅሩህ የተባረከ ይሆናል፥ ከእንጀራው ለድሀ ሰጥቶአልና።

verses.en: Cast out the scorner, and contention shall go out; yea, strife and reproach shall cease.
verses.am: ፌዘኛን ብታወጣ ክርክር ይወጣል፥ ጠብና ስድብም ያልቃል።

verses.en: He that loveth pureness of heart, for the grace of his lips the king shall be his friend.
verses.am: የልብን ንጽሕና የሚወድድና ሞገስ በከንፈሩ ያለች፥ ንጉሥ ወዳጁ ይሆናል።

verses.en: The eyes of YAHUAH preserve knowledge, and he overthroweth the words of the transgressor.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ዓይኖች እውቀትን ይጠብቃሉ፤ እርሱ ግን የወስላታውን ቃል ይገለብጣል።

verses.en: The slothful man saith, There is a lion without, I shall be slain in the streets.
verses.am: ታካች ሰው። አንበሳ በሜዳ ነው፤ በመንገዱ ላይ እሞታለሁ ይላል።

verses.en: The mouth of strange women is a deep pit: he that is abhorred of YAHUAH shall fall therein.
verses.am: የጋለሞታ ሴት አፍ የጠለቀ ጕድጓድ ነው፤ እግዚአብሔር የተቈጣው በእርስዋ ይወድቃል።

verses.en: Foolishness is bound in the heart of a child; but the rod of correction shall drive it far from him.
verses.am: ስንፍና በሕፃን ልብ ታስሮአል፤ የተግሣጽ በትር ግን ከእርሱ ያርቃታል።

verses.en: He that oppresseth the poor to increase his riches, and he that giveth to the rich, shall surely come to want.
verses.am: ለራሱ ጥቅም ለመጨመር ሲል ድሀን የሚጐዳ፥ ለባለጠጋም የሚሰጥ፥ እርሱ ወደ ድህነት ይወድቃል።

verses.en: Bow down thine ear, and hear the words of the wise, and apply thine heart unto my knowledge.
verses.am: ጆሮህን አዘንብለህ የጠቢባንን ቃላት ስማ፥ ልብህንም ወደ እውቀቴ አድርግ፤

verses.en: For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee; they shall withal be fitted in thy lips.
verses.am: እነርሱን በውስጥህ ብትጠብቅ፥ በከንፈሮችህም ላይ የተዘጋጁ ቢሆኑ፥ የተወደደ ነገር ይሆንልሃልና።

verses.en: That thy trust may be in YAHUAH, I have made known to thee this day, even to thee.
verses.am: እምነትህ በእግዚአብሔር ይሆን ዘንድ ለአንተ ዛሬ እነሆ አስታወቅሁህ።

verses.en: Have not I written to thee excellent things in counsels and knowledge,
verses.am: ድሀን በግድ አትበለው ድሀ ነውና፤ ችግረኛውንም በበር አትግፋው፤

verses.en: That I might make thee know the certainty of the words of truth; that thou mightest answer the words of truth to them that send unto thee?
verses.am: ድሀን በግድ አትበለው ድሀ ነውና፤ ችግረኛውንም በበር አትግፋው፤

verses.en: Rob not the poor, because he is poor: neither oppress the afflicted in the gate:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር የእነርሱን ፍርድ ይፋረድላቸዋልና፥ የቀሙአቸውንም ሰዎች ሕይወት ይቀማልና።

verses.en: For YAHUAH will plead their cause, and spoil the soul of those that spoiled them.
verses.am: ከቍጡ ሰው ጋር ባልንጀራ አትሁን፥ ከወፈፍተኛም ጋት አትሂድ፥

verses.en: Make no friendship with an angry man; and with a furious man thou shalt not go:
verses.am: መንገዱን እንዳትማር ለነፍስህም ወጥመድ እንዳታገኝህ።

verses.en: Lest thou learn his ways, and get a snare to thy soul.
verses.am: እጃቸውን አጋና እንደሚማቱ፥ ለባለ ዕዳዎች እንደሚዋሱ አትሁን፤

verses.en: Be not thou one of them that strike hands, or of them that are sureties for debts.
verses.am: የምትከፍለው ባይኖርህ፥ ምንጣፍህን ከበታችህ ስለ ምን ይወስዳል?

verses.en: If thou hast nothing to pay, why should he take away thy bed from under thee?
verses.am: አባቶችህ የሠሩትን የቀድሞውን የድንበር ምልክት አታፍልስ።

verses.en: Remove not the ancient landmark, which thy fathers have set.
verses.am: በሥራው የቀጠፈ ሰውን አይተሃልን? በነገሥታት ፊት ይቆማል፤ በተዋረዱም ሰዎች ፊት አይቆምም።

verses.en: Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men.
When thou sittest to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before thee:
verses.am: ከመኰንን ጋር ለመብላት በተቀመጥህ ጊዜ፥ በፊትህ ያለውን በደኅና አስተውል፤

verses.en: And put a knife to thy throat, if thou be a man given to appetite.
verses.am: ሰውነትህም ቢሳሳ፥ በጕሮሮህ ላይ ካራ አድርግ።

verses.en: Be not desirous of his dainties: for they are deceitful meat.
verses.am: ጣፋጩ መብል አይመርህ የሐሰት እንጀራ ነውና።

verses.en: Labour not to be rich: cease from thine own wisdom.
verses.am: ባለጠጋ ለመሆን አትድከም፤ የገዛ ራስህን ማስተዋል ተው።

verses.en: Wilt thou set thine eyes upon that which is not? for riches certainly make themselves wings; they fly away as an eagle toward heaven.
verses.am: በእርሱ ላይ ዓይንህን ብታዘወትርበት ይጠፋል፤ ባለጠግነት ወደ ሰማይ እንደሚበርር እንደ ንስር ለራሱ ክንፍ ያበጃልና።

verses.en: Eat thou not the bread of him that hath an evil eye, neither desire thou his dainty meats:
verses.am: የቀናተኛን ሰው እንጀራ አትብላ፥ ጣፋጩ መብልም አይመርህ፤

verses.en: For as he thinketh in his heart, so is he: Eat and drink, saith he to thee; but his heart is not with thee.
verses.am: በልቡ እንዳሰበ እንዲሁ ነውና፤ ብላ ጠጣ ይልሃል፥ ልቡ ግን ካንተ ጋር አይደለም።

verses.en: The morsel which thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up, and lose thy sweet words.
verses.am: የበላኸውን መብል ትተፋዋለህ፥ ያማረውንም ቃልህን ታጠፋዋለህ።

verses.en: Speak not in the ears of a fool: for he will despise the wisdom of thy words.
verses.am: በሰነፍ ጆሮ አንዳች አትናገር፥ የቃልህን ጥበብ ያፌዝብሃልና።

verses.en: Remove not the old landmark; and enter not into the fields of the fatherless:
verses.am: የቀድሞውን የድንበር ምልክት አታፍልስ፤ ወደ ድሀ አደጎች እርሻ አትግባ፤

verses.en: For their redeemer is mighty; he shall plead their cause with thee.
verses.am: ታዳጊአቸው ጽኑ ነውና፥ እርሱም ፍርዳቸውን ከአንተ ጋር ይፋረዳልና።

verses.en: Apply thine heart unto instruction, and thine ears to the words of knowledge.
verses.am: ልብህን ለተግሣጽ ስጥ፥ ጆሮህንም ወደ እውቀት ቃል።

verses.en: Withhold not correction from the child: for if thou beatest him with the rod, he shall not die.
verses.am: ሕፃንን ከመቅጣት ቸል አትበል፥ በበትር ብትመታው አይሞትምና።

verses.en: Thou shalt beat him with the rod, and shalt deliver his soul from hell.
verses.am: በበትር ትመታዋለህ፥ ነፍሱንም ትታደጋለህ።

verses.en: My son, if thine heart be wise, my heart shall rejoice, even mine.
verses.am: ልጄ ሆይ፥ ልብህ ጠቢብ ቢሆን ልቤ ደግሞ ደስ ይለዋል፤

verses.en: Yea, my reins shall rejoice, when thy lips speak right things.
verses.am: ከንፈሮችህም በቅን ቢናገሩ ኵላሊቶቼ ደስ ይላቸዋል።

verses.en: Let not thine heart envy sinners: but be thou in the fear of YAHUAH all the day long.
verses.am: ልብህ በኃጢአተኞች አይቅና፤ ነገር ግን ቀኑን ሙሉ እግዚአብሔርን በመፍራት ኑር፤

verses.en: For surely there is an end; and thine expectation shall not be cut off.
verses.am: በእውነት ፍጻሜ አለህና፥ ተስፋህም አይጠፋምና።

verses.en: Hear thou, my son, and be wise, and guide thine heart in the way.
verses.am: ልጄ ሆይ፥ ስማ ጠቢብም ሁን ልብህንም በቀናው መንገድ ምራ።

verses.en: Be not among winebibbers; among riotous eaters of flesh:
verses.am: የወይን ጠጅ ከሚጠጡ ጋር አትቀመጥ ለሥጋም ከሚሣሡ ጋር፤

verses.en: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty: and drowsiness shall clothe a man with rags.
verses.am: ሰካርና ሆዳም ይደኸያሉና፥ የእንቅልፍም ብዛት የተቦጫጨቀ ጨርቅ ያስለብሳልና።

verses.en: Hearken unto thy father that begat thee, and despise not thy mother when she is old.
verses.am: የወለደህን አባትህን ስማ፥ እናትህም ባረጀች ጊዜ አትናቃት።

verses.en: Buy the truth, and sell it not; also wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.
verses.am: እውነትን ግዛ አትሽጣትም፥ ጥበብን ተግሣጽን ማስተዋልንም።

verses.en: The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice: and he that begetteth a wise child shall have joy of him.
verses.am: የጻድቅ አባት እጅግ ደስ ይለዋል፥ ጠቢብንም ልጅ የወለደ ሐሤትን ያገኛል።

verses.en: Thy father and thy mother shall be glad, and she that bare thee shall rejoice.
verses.am: አባትህና እናትህ ደስ ይበላቸው፥ አንተንም የወለደች ደስ ይበላት።

verses.en: My son, give me thine heart, and let thine eyes observe my ways.
verses.am: ልጄ ሆይ፥ ልብህን ስጠኝ፥ ዓይኖችህም መንገዴን ይውደዱ፤

verses.en: For a whore is a deep ditch; and a strange woman is a narrow pit.
verses.am: ጋለሞታ ሴት የጠለቀች ዐዘቅት ናትና፥ ሌላይቱም ሴት የጠበበች ጕድጓድ ናትና።

verses.en: She also lieth in wait as for a prey, and increaseth the transgressors among men.
verses.am: እንደ ሌባ ታደባለች ወስላቶችንም በሰው ልጆች መካከል ታበዛለች።

verses.en: Who hath woe? who hath sorrow? who hath contentions? who hath babbling? who hath wounds without cause? who hath redness of eyes?
verses.am: ዋይታ ለማን ነው? ኀዘን ለማን ነው? ጠብ ለማን ነው? ጩኸት ለማን ነው? ያለ ምክንያት መቍሰል ለማን ነው? የዓይን ቅላት ለማን ነው?

verses.en: They that tarry long at the wine; they that go to seek mixed wine.
verses.am: የወይን ጠጅ በመጠጣት ለሚዘገዩ አይደለምን? የተደባለቀ የወይንን ጠጅ ይፈትኑ ዘንድ ለሚከተሉ አይደለምን?

verses.en: Look not thou upon the wine when it is red, when it giveth his colour in the cup, when it moveth itself aright.
verses.am: ወደ ወይን ጠጅ አትመልከት በቀላ ጊዜ፥ መልኩም በብርሌ ባንጸባረቀ ጊዜ፥ እየጣፈጠም በገባ ጊዜ።

verses.en: At the last it biteth like a serpent, and stingeth like an adder.
verses.am: በኋላ እንደ እባብ ይነድፋል፥ እንደ እፉኝትም መርዙን ያፈስሳል።

verses.en: Thine eyes shall behold strange women, and thine heart shall utter perverse things.
verses.am: ዓይኖችህ ጋለሞታዎችን ያያሉ፥ ልብህም ጠማማ ነገርን ይናገራል።

verses.en: Yea, thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea, or as he that lieth upon the top of a mast.
verses.am: በባሕር ውስጥ እንደ ተኛ ትሆናለህ፥ በደቀልም ላይ እንደ ተኛ።

verses.en: They have stricken me, shalt thou say, and I was not sick; they have beaten me, and I felt it not: when shall I awake? I will seek it yet again.
verses.am: መቱኝ፥ ያውም አልተሰማኝም፤ ጐሰሙኝ፥ አላወቅሁምም። መቼ እነሣለሁ? ደግሞ ጨምሬ እሻታለሁ ትላለህ።

verses.en: Be not thou envious against evil men, neither desire to be with them.
verses.am: ልጄ ሆይ፥ በክፉ ሰዎች አትቅና፥ ከእነርሱ ጋርም መሆንን አትውደድ፤

verses.en: For their heart studieth destruction, and their lips talk of mischief.
verses.am: ልባቸው ግፍን ታስባለችና፥ ከንፈራቸውም ሽንገላን ትናገራለችና።

verses.en: Through wisdom is an house builded; and by understanding it is established:
verses.am: ቤት በጥበብ ይሠራል፥ በማስተዋልም ይጸናል።

verses.en: And by knowledge shall the chambers be filled with all precious and pleasant riches.
verses.am: በእውቀት ከከበረውና ካማረው ሀብት ሁሉ ጓዳዎች ይሞላሉ።

verses.en: A wise man is strong; yea, a man of knowledge increaseth strength.
verses.am: ጠቢብ ሰው ብርቱ ነው፥ አዋቂም ሰው ኃይሉን ያበዛል።

verses.en: For by wise counsel thou shalt make thy war: and in multitude of counsellors there is safety.
verses.am: በመልካም ሥርዓት ሰልፍ ታደርጋለህ፤ ድልም ብዙ ምክር ባለበት ዘንድ ነው።

verses.en: Wisdom is too high for a fool: he openeth not his mouth in the gate.
verses.am: ጥበብ ለሰነፍ ከፍ ብላ የራቀች ናት፤ በበርም አፉን አይከፍትም።

verses.en: He that deviseth to do evil shall be called a mischievous person.
verses.am: ክፉ ለማድረግ የሚያስብ ተንኰለኛ ይባላል።

verses.en: The thought of foolishness is sin: and the scorner is an abomination to men.
verses.am: የስንፍና ሐሳብ ኃጢአት ነው፤ ሰዎች ፌዘኛውን ይጸየፉታል።

verses.en: If thou faint in the day of adversity, thy strength is small.
verses.am: በመከራ ቀን ብትላላ ጉልበትህ ጥቂት ነው።

verses.en: If thou forbear to deliver them that are drawn unto death, and those that are ready to be slain;
verses.am: ወደ ሞት የሚነዱትን ታደግ፤ ሊታረዱ የተወሰኑትን አድን።

verses.en: If thou sayest, Behold, we knew it not; doth not he that pondereth the heart consider it? and he that keepeth thy soul, doth not he know it? and shall not he render to every man according to his works?
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ይህን አላወቀውም ብትል፥ ልቦችን የሚመረምር እርሱ አያስተውልምን? ነፍስህንም የሚመለከት እርሱ አያውቅምን? ለሰውስ ሁሉ እንደ ሥራው አይመልስለትምን?

verses.en: My son, eat thou honey, because it is good; and the honeycomb, which is sweet to thy taste:
verses.am: ልጄ ሆይ፥ መልካም ነውና ማር ብላ፤ ወለላም ለጣምህ ጣፋጭ ነው።

verses.en: So shall the knowledge of wisdom be unto thy soul: when thou hast found it, then there shall be a reward, and thy expectation shall not be cut off.
verses.am: ጥበብም ለነፍስህ እንዲሁ እንደሚሆን እወቅ፤ ብታገኘውም ፍጻሜህ መልካም ይሆናል፥ ተስፋህም አይጠፋም።

verses.en: Lay not wait, O wicked man, against the dwelling of the righteous; spoil not his resting place:
verses.am: እንደ ኀጥእ በጻድቅ ቤት ላይ አትሸምቅ፤ ማደሪያውንም አታውክ።

verses.en: For a just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again: but the wicked shall fall into mischief.
verses.am: ጻድቅ ሰባት ጊዜ ይወድቃልና፥ ይነሣማል፤ ኀጥኣን ግን በክፉ ላይ ይወድቃሉ።

verses.en: Rejoice not when thine enemy falleth, and let not thine heart be glad when he stumbleth:
verses.am: ጠላትህ ቢወድቅ ደስ አይበልህ፥ በመሰናከሉም ልብህ ሐሤት አያድርግ፥

verses.en: Lest YAHUAH see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ያንን አይቶ በዓይኑ ክፉ እንዳይሆን፥ ቍጣውንም ከእርሱ እንዳይመልስ።

verses.en: Fret not thyself because of evil men, neither be thou envious at the wicked;
verses.am: ስለ ኃጢአተኞች አትቈጣ፥ በክፉዎችም አትቅና።

verses.en: For there shall be no reward to the evil man; the candle of the wicked shall be put out.
verses.am: ለኃጢአተኛ የፍጻሜ ተስፋ የለውምና፥ የኅጥኣንም መብራት ይጠፋልና።

verses.en: My son, fear thou YAHUAH and the king: and meddle not with them that are given to change:
verses.am: ልጄ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔርንና ንጉሥን ፍራ፥ ከዓመፀኞችም ጋር አትደባለቅ።

verses.en: For their calamity shall rise suddenly; and who knoweth the ruin of them both?
verses.am: መከራቸው ድንገት ይነሣልና፤ ከሁለቱ የሚመጣውን ጥፋት ማን ያውቃል?  ፍን [የሚቀጥለው ከግሪክ የተጨመረ ነው።] የነገሩትን የሚሰማ ልጅ ከጥፋት የራቀ ነው፤ የነገሩትን የሚቀበልን ሰው እግዚአብሔር ይቀበለዋል። ከንጉሥ አንደበት ምንምን ሐሰት ይነገራል አይባልም፤ ከአንደበቱም የሚወጣ ሐሰት የለም። የንጉሥ ቃል ሾተል ናት፤ ለጥፋት የተሰጠችውን ሰው ሰውነት ታጠፋዋለች እንጂ አንድ አካል ብቻ የምታጠፋ አይደለም። ሰይፍ መዓቱ ብትሳል ግን ከወገኑ ጋር ሰውን ታጠፋለች፤ ከአሞሮች ግልገል ወገን የማይበላ እስኪሆን ድረስ እንደ እሳት ነበልባል ታቃጥላለች።

verses.en: These things also belong to the wise. It is not good to have respect of persons in judgment.
verses.am: እነዚህ ደግሞ የጠቢባን ቃሎች ናቸው። በፍርድ ታደላ ዘንድ መልካም አይደለም።

verses.en: He that saith unto the wicked, Thou art righteous; him shall the people curse, nations shall abhor him:
verses.am: ኀጥኡን። ጻድቅ ነህ የሚለውን ወገኖች ይረግሙታል አሕዛብም ይጠሉታል፤

verses.en: But to them that rebuke him shall be delight, and a good blessing shall come upon them.
verses.am: የሚዘልፉት ግን ደስታ ይሆንላቸዋል፥ በላያቸውም መልካም በረከት ትመጣላቸዋለች።

verses.en: Every man shall kiss his lips that giveth a right answer.
verses.am: በቀና ነገር የሚመልስ ከንፈርን ይስማል።

verses.en: Prepare thy work without, and make it fit for thyself in the field; and afterwards build thine house.
verses.am: በስተ ሜዳ ሥራህን አሰናዳ፥ ስለ አንተ በእርሻ አዘጋጃት፤ ከዚያም በኋላ ቤትህን ሥራ።

verses.en: Be not a witness against thy neighbour without cause; and deceive not with thy lips.
verses.am: በባልንጀራህ ላይ በከንቱ ምስክር አትሁን፥ በከንፈርህም አታባብለው።

verses.en: Say not, I will do so to him as he hath done to me: I will render to the man according to his work.
verses.am: እንዳደረገብኝ እንዲሁ አደርግበታለሁ፥ እንደ ሥራውም እመልስበታለሁ አትበል።

verses.en: I went by the field of the slothful, and by the vineyard of the man void of understanding;
verses.am: በታካች ሰው እርሻ፥ አእምሮ በጐደለውም ሰው ወይን ቦታ አለፍሁ።

verses.en: And, lo, it was all grown over with thorns, and nettles had covered the face thereof, and the stone wall thereof was broken down.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ሁሉ እሾህ ሞልቶበታል፥ ፊቱንም ሳማ ሸፍኖታል፥ የድንጋዩም ቅጥር ፈርሶአል።

verses.en: Then I saw, and considered it well: I looked upon it, and received instruction.
verses.am: ተመለከትሁና አሰብሁ፤ አየሁትና ተግሣጽን ተቀበልሁ።

verses.en: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
verses.am: ጥቂት ትተኛለህ፥ ጥቂትም ታንቀላፋለህ፥ ትተኛም ዘንድ ጥቂት እጅህን ታጥፋለህ፤

verses.en: So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth; and thy want as an armed man.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ድህነትህ እንደ ወንበዴ፥ ችጋርህም ሰይፍ እንደ ታጠቀ ሰው ይመጣብሃል። [በግዕዝ መጽሐፈ ተግሣጽ ይባላል]

verses.en: These are also proverbs of Shelomoh, which the men of Hezekiah king of Yehudah copied out.
verses.am: እነዚህም ደግሞ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ የሕዝቅያስ ሰዎች የቀዱአቸው የሰሎሞን ምሳሌዎች ናቸው።

verses.en: It is the glory of YAHUAH to conceal a thing: but the honour of kings is to search out a matter.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ክብር ነገርን መሰወር ነው፤ የነገሥታት ክብር ግን ነገርን መመርመር ነው።

verses.en: The heaven for height, and the earth for depth, and the heart of kings is unsearchable.
verses.am: እንደ ሰማይ ከፍታ እንደ ምድርም ጥልቀት የነገሥታት ልብ አይመረመርም።

verses.en: Take away the dross from the silver, and there shall come forth a vessel for the finer.
verses.am: ከብር ዝገትን አስወግድ፥ ፈጽሞም ይጠራል።

verses.en: Take away the wicked from before the king, and his throne shall be established in righteousness.
verses.am: ከንጉሥ ፊት ኀጥኣንን አርቅ፥ ዙፋኑም በጽድቅ ትጸናለች።

verses.en: Put not forth thyself in the presence of the king, and stand not in the place of great men:
verses.am: በንጉሥ ፊት አትመካ፥ በታላልቆችም ስፍራ አትቁም፤

verses.en: For better it is that it be said unto thee, Come up hither; than that thou shouldest be put lower in the presence of the prince whom thine eyes have seen.
verses.am: ዓይኖችህ ባዩት በመኰንን ፊት ከምትዋረድ። ወደዚህ ከፍ በል ብትባል ይሻልሃልና።

verses.en: Go not forth hastily to strive, lest thou know not what to do in the end thereof, when thy neighbour hath put thee to shame.
verses.am: ባልንጀራህ ባሳፈረህ ጊዜ ኋላ እንዳትጸጸት ለክርክር ፈጥነህ አትውጣ፤

verses.en: Debate thy cause with thy neighbour himself; and discover not a secret to another:
verses.am: ክርክርህን ከባልንጀራህ ጋር ተከራከር፤ የሌላ ሰው ምሥጢር ግን አትግለጥ፥

verses.en: Lest he that heareth it put thee to shame, and thine infamy turn not away.
verses.am: የሚሰማ እንዳይነቅፍህ፥ አንተንም ከማነወር ዝም እንዳይል።

verses.en: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver.
verses.am: የወርቅ እንኮይ በብር ፃሕል ላይ፤ የጊዜው ቃል እንዲሁ ነው።

verses.en: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover upon an obedient ear.
verses.am: የምትሰማን ጆሮ የሚዘልፍ ጠቢብ ሰው እንደ ወርቅ ጉትቻ እንደሚያንጸባርቅም ዕንቍ እንዲሁ ነው።

verses.en: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to them that send him: for he refresheth the soul of his masters.
verses.am: በመከር ወራት የውርጭ ጠል ደስ እንደሚያሰኝ፥ እንዲሁ የታመነ መልእክተኛ ለላኩት ነው፤ የጌቶቹን ነፍስ ያሳርፋልና።

verses.en: Whoso boasteth himself of a false gift is like clouds and wind without rain.
verses.am: ስለ ስጦታው በሐሰት የሚመካ ሰው ዝናብ እንደማይከተለው ደመና ነፋስም ነው።

verses.en: By long forbearing is a prince persuaded, and a soft tongue breaketh the bone.
verses.am: በትዕግሥት አለቃ ይለዝባል፥ የገራም ምላስ አጥንትን ይሰብራል።

verses.en: Hast thou found honey? eat so much as is sufficient for thee, lest thou be filled therewith, and vomit it.
verses.am: አጥብቀህ እንዳትጠግብ እንዳትተፋውም ማር ባገኘህ ጊዜ የሚበቃህን ብላ።

verses.en: Withdraw thy foot from thy neighbour's house; lest he be weary of thee, and so hate thee.
verses.am: እንዳይሰለችህ እንዳይጠላህም እግርህን ወደ ባልንጀራህ ቤት አታዘውትር።

verses.en: A man that beareth false witness against his neighbour is a maul, and a sword, and a sharp arrow.
verses.am: በባልንጀራው በሐሰት የሚመሰክር እንደ መዶሻና እንደ ሰይፍ እንደ ተሳለም ፍላጻ ነው።

verses.en: Confidence in an unfaithful man in time of trouble is like a broken tooth, and a foot out of joint.
verses.am: ወስላታውን ሰው በመከራ ጊዜ መተማመን እንደ ተሰበረ ጥርስና እንደ ሰለለ እግር ነው።

verses.en: As he that taketh away a garment in cold weather, and as vinegar upon nitre, so is he that singeth songs to an heavy heart.
verses.am: ለሚያዝን ልብ ዝማሬ የሚዘምር፥ ለብርድ ቀን መጐናጸፊያውን እንደሚያስወግድ በቍስልም ላይ እንደ መጻጻ እንዲሁ ነው።

verses.en: If thine enemy be hungry, give him bread to eat; and if he be thirsty, give him water to drink:
verses.am: ጠላትህ ቢራብ እንጀራ አብላው፥ ቢጠማም ውኃ አጠጣው፤

verses.en: For thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head, and YAHUAH shall reward thee.
verses.am: ፍም በራሱ ላይ ትሰበስባለህና፥ እግዚአብሔርም ዋጋህን ይመልስልሃልና።

verses.en: The north wind driveth away rain: so doth an angry countenance a backbiting tongue.
verses.am: የሰሜን ነፋስ ወጀብ ያመጣል፤ ሐሜተኛ ምላስም የሰውን ፊት ያስቈጣል።

verses.en: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman and in a wide house.
verses.am: ከጠበኛ ሴት ጋር በአንድ ቤት ከመቀመጥ በሰገነት ማዕዘን መቀመጥ ይሻላል።

verses.en: As cold waters to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.
verses.am: የቀዘቀዘ ውኃ ለተጠማች ነፍስ ደስ እንደሚያሰኝ፥ ከሩቅ አገር የመጣ መልካም ምስራች እንዲሁ ነው።

verses.en: A righteous man falling down before the wicked is as a troubled fountain, and a corrupt spring.
verses.am: በኀጥእ ፊት የሚወድቅ ጻድቅ እንደደፈረሰ ፈሳሽና እንደ ረከሰ ምንጭ ነው።

verses.en: It is not good to eat much honey: so for men to search their own glory is not glory.
verses.am: ብዙ ማር መብላት መልካም አይደለም፤ እንዲሁም የራስን ክብር መፈላለግ አያስከብርም።

verses.en: He that hath no rule over his own spirit is like a city that is broken down, and without walls.
verses.am: ቅጥር እንደሌላት እንደ ፈረሰች ከተማ፥ መንፈሱን የማይከለክል ሰው እንዲሁ ነው።

verses.en: As snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honour is not seemly for a fool.
verses.am: በረዶ በበጋ ዝናብም በመከር እንዳይገባ፥ እንዲሁ ለሰነፍ ክብር አይገባውም።

verses.en: As the bird by wandering, as the swallow by flying, so the curse causeless shall not come.
verses.am: እንደሚተላለፍ ድንቢጥ ወዲያና ወዲህም እንደሚበርር ጨረባ፥ እንዲሁ ከንቱ እርግማን በማንም ላይ አይደርስም።

verses.en: A whip for the horse, a bridle for the ass, and a rod for the fool's back.
verses.am: አለንጋ ለፈረስ፥ ልጓም ለአህያ፥ በትርም ለሰነፍ ጀርባ ነው።

verses.en: Answer not a fool according to his folly, lest thou also be like unto him.
verses.am: አንተ ደግሞ እርሱን እንዳትመስል ለሰነፍ እንደ ስንፍናው አትመልስለት።

verses.en: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own conceit.
verses.am: ለራሱ ጠቢብ የሆነ እንዳይመስለው ለሰነፍ እንደ ስንፍናው መልስለት።

verses.en: He that sendeth a message by the hand of a fool cutteth off the feet, and drinketh damage.
verses.am: በሰነፍ መልእክተኛ እጅ ነገርን የሚልክ እግሮቹን ይቈርጣል ግፍንም ይጠጣል።

verses.en: The legs of the lame are not equal: so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
verses.am: እንደሚንጠለጠሉ የአንካሳ እግሮች፥ እንዲሁም ምሳሌ በሰነፎች አፍ ነው።

verses.en: As he that bindeth a stone in a sling, so is he that giveth honour to a fool.
verses.am: ለሰነፍ ክብርን የሚሰጥ ድንጋይን በወንጭፍ እንደሚያስር ነው።

verses.en: As a thorn goeth up into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.
verses.am: እሾህ በስካር እጅ እንደሚሰካ፥ እንዲሁ ምሳሌ በሰነፎች አፍ ነው።

verses.en: The great YAHUAH that formed all things both rewardeth the fool, and rewardeth transgressors.
verses.am: ዋና ሠራተኛ ሁሉን ነገር ይሠራል፤ ሰነፍን የሚቀጥር ግን መንገድ አላፊውን እንደሚቀጥር ነው።

verses.en: As a dog returneth to his vomit, so a fool returneth to his folly.
verses.am: ወደ ትፋቱ እንደሚመለስ ውሻ ስንፍናውን የሚደግም ሰው እንዲሁ ነው።

verses.en: Seest thou a man wise in his own conceit? there is more hope of a fool than of him.
verses.am: ለራሱ ጠቢብ የሆነ የሚምስለውን ሰው አየኽውን? ከእርሱ ይልቅ ለሰነፍ ተስፋ አለው።

verses.en: The slothful man saith, There is a lion in the way; a lion is in the streets.
verses.am: ታካች ሰው። አንበሳ በመንገድ አለ፤ አንበሳ በጎዳና አለ ይላል።

verses.en: As the door turneth upon his hinges, so doth the slothful upon his bed.
verses.am: ሣንቃ በማጠፊያው ላይ እንደሚዞር፥ እንዲሁ ታካች ሰው በአልጋው ላይ ይመላለሳል።

verses.en: The slothful hideth his hand in his bosom; it grieveth him to bring it again to his mouth.
verses.am: ታካች ሰው እጁን ወደ ወጭት ያጠልቃል፤ ወደ አፉም ይመልሳት ዘንድ ለእርሱ ድካም ነው።

verses.en: The sluggard is wiser in his own conceit than seven men that can render a reason.
verses.am: ታካች ሰው በጥበብ ከሚመልሱ ከሰባት ሰዎች ይልቅ ለራሱ ጠቢብ የሆነ ይመስለዋል።

verses.en: He that passeth by, and meddleth with strife belonging not to him, is like one that taketh a dog by the ears.
verses.am: አልፎ በሌላው ጥል የሚደባለቅ ውሻን በጅራቱ እንደሚይዝ ነው።

verses.en: As a mad man who casteth firebrands, arrows, and death,
verses.am: ትንታግንና ፍላጻን ሞትንም እንደሚወረውር እንደ ዕብድ ሰው፥

verses.en: So is the man that deceiveth his neighbour, and saith, Am not I in sport?
verses.am: ባልንጀራውን የሚያታልል። በጨዋታ አደረግሁት የሚል ሰውም እንዲሁ ነው።

verses.en: Where no wood is, there the fire goeth out: so where there is no talebearer, the strife ceaseth.
verses.am: እንጨት ባለቀ ጊዜ እሳት ይጠፋል፤ ጆሮ ጠቢ በሌለበትም ዘንድ ጠብ ጸጥ ይላል።

verses.en: As coals are to burning coals, and wood to fire; so is a contentious man to kindle strife.
verses.am: ከሰል ፍምን እንጨትም እሳትን እንዲያበዛ፥ እንዲሁ ቍጡ ሰው ጠብን ያበዛል።

verses.en: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.
verses.am: የጆሮ ጠቢ ቃል እንደ ጣፋጭ መብል ነው፥ እርሱም እስከ ሆድ ጕርጆች ድረስ ይወርዳል።

verses.en: Burning lips and a wicked heart are like a potsherd covered with silver dross.
verses.am: ክፋት በልቡ ሳለ ፍቅርን የሚናገር ከንፈር በብር ዝገት እንደ ተለበጠ የሸክላ ዕቅ ነው።

verses.en: He that hateth dissembleth with his lips, and layeth up deceit within him;
verses.am: ጠላት በከንፈሩ ተስፋ ይሰጣል፥ በልቡ ግን ተንኰልን ያኖራል።

verses.en: When he speaketh fair, believe him not: for there are seven abominations in his heart.
verses.am: በልቡ ሰባት ርኵሰት አለበትና በቃሉ አሳምሮ ቢናገርህ አትመነው።

verses.en: Whose hatred is covered by deceit, his wickedness shall be shewed before the whole congregation.
verses.am: ጠላትነቱን በተንኰል የሚሸሽግ፥ ክፋቱ በጉባኤ መካከል ይገለጣል።

verses.en: Whoso diggeth a pit shall fall therein: and he that rolleth a stone, it will return upon him.
verses.am: ጕድጓድን የሚምስ ይወድቅበታል፤ ድንጋይንም የሚያንከባልል ይገለበጥበታል።

verses.en: A lying tongue hateth those that are afflicted by it; and a flattering mouth worketh ruin.
verses.am: ሐሰተኛ ምላስ ያቈሰላቸውን ሰዎች ይጠላል፤ ልዝብ አፍም ጥፋትን ያመጣል።

verses.en: Boast not thyself of to morrow; for thou knowest not what a day may bring forth.
verses.am: ቀን የሚያመጣውን ምን እንደ ሆነ አታውቅምና ነገ በሚሆነው አትመካ።

verses.en: Let another man praise thee, and not thine own mouth; a stranger, and not thine own lips.
verses.am: ሌላ ያመስግንህ እንጂ አፍህ አይደለም፤ ባዕድ ሰው እንጂ ከንፈርህ አይደለም።

verses.en: A stone is heavy, and the sand weighty; but a fool's wrath is heavier than them both.
verses.am: ድንጋይ ከባድ ነው አሸዋም ሸክሙ ጽኑ ነው፤ ከሁለቱ ግን የሰነፍ ቍጣ ይከብዳል።

verses.en: Wrath is cruel, and anger is outrageous; but who is able to stand before envy?
verses.am: ቍጣ ምሕረት የሌለው ነው፥ መዓትም እንደ ጎርፍ ነው፤ በቅንዓት ፊት ግን ማን ይቆማል?

verses.en: Open rebuke is better than secret love.
verses.am: የተገለጠ ዘለፋ ከተሰወረ ፍቅር ይሻላል።

verses.en: Faithful are the wounds of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.
verses.am: የወዳጅ ማቍሰል የታመነ ነው፤ የጠላት መሳም ግን የበዛ ነው።

verses.en: The full soul loatheth an honeycomb; but to the hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet.
verses.am: የጠገበች ነፍስ የማር ወላላ ትረግጣለች፤ ለተራበች ነፍስ ግን የመረረ ነገር ሁሉ ይጣፍጣታል።

verses.en: As a bird that wandereth from her nest, so is a man that wandereth from his place.
verses.am: ስፍራውን የሚተው ሰው፤ ቤቱን ትቶ እንደሚበርር ወፍ ነው።

verses.en: Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart: so doth the sweetness of a man's friend by hearty counsel.
verses.am: ሽቱና ዕጣን ልብን ደስ ያሰኛሉ፤ እንዲሁ ነፍስ በወዳጁ ምክር ደስ ይላታል።

verses.en: Thine own friend, and thy father's friend, forsake not; neither go into thy brother's house in the day of thy calamity: for better is a neighbour that is near than a brother far off.
verses.am: ወዳጅህንና የአባትህን ወዳጅ አትተው፤ በመከራህም ቀን ወደ ወንድምህ ቤት አትግባ፤ የቀረበ ወዳጅ ከራቀ ወንድም ይሻላል።

verses.en: My son, be wise, and make my heart glad, that I may answer him that reproacheth me.
verses.am: ልጄ ሆይ፥ ጠቢብ ሁን፥ ልቤንም ደስ አሰኘው፥ ለሚሰድበኝ መልስ መስጠት ይቻለኝ ዘንድ።

verses.en: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself; but the simple pass on, and are punished.
verses.am: ብልህ ሰው ክፉን አይቶ ይሸሸጋል፤ አላዋቂዎች ግን አልፈው ይጐዳሉ።

verses.en: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger, and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.
verses.am: ለማያውቀው ከተዋሰ ሰው ልብሱን ውሰድ፥ ለእንግዳ የተዋሰውንም እርሱን አግተው።

verses.en: He that blesseth his friend with a loud voice, rising early in the morning, it shall be counted a curse to him.
verses.am: ባልንጀራውን በታላቅ ቃል ማለዳ የሚባርክ ሰው እንደሚራገም ያህል ነው።

verses.en: A continual dropping in a very rainy day and a contentious woman are alike.
verses.am: በዝናብ ቀን የሚያንጠባጥብ ቤትና ጠበኛ ሴት አንድ ናቸው፤

verses.en: Whosoever hideth her hideth the wind, and the ointment of his right hand, which bewrayeth itself.
verses.am: እርስዋንም መከልከል ነፍስን መከልከልና ዘይትን በቀኝ እጅ መጨበጥ ነው።

verses.en: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.
verses.am: ብረት ብረትን ይስለዋል፥ ሰውም ባልንጀራውን ይስላል።

verses.en: Whoso keepeth the fig tree shall eat the fruit thereof: so he that waiteth on his master shall be honoured.
verses.am: በለሱን የጠበቀ ፍሬዋን ይበላል፥ ጌታውንም የሚጠብቅ ይከብራል።

verses.en: As in water face answereth to face, so the heart of man to man.
verses.am: ፊት በውኃ ላይ ለፊት እንደሚታይ፥ እንዲሁ የሰው ልብ ለሰው ይታያል።

verses.en: Hell and destruction are never full; so the eyes of man are never satisfied.
verses.am: ሲኦልና ጥፋት እንዳይጠግቡ፥ እንዲሁ የሰው ዓይን አይጠግብም።

verses.en: As the fining pot for silver, and the furnace for gold; so is a man to his praise.
verses.am: ብር በከውር ወርቅም በማቅለጫ ይፈተናል፤ ሰውም በሚያመሰገኑት ሰዎች አፍ ይፈተናል።

verses.en: Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle, yet will not his foolishness depart from him.
verses.am: ሰነፍን በሙቀጫ ውስጥ ከእህል ጋር በዘነዘና ብትወቅጠው፥ ስንፍናው ከእርሱ አይርቅም።

verses.en: Be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks, and look well to thy herds.
verses.am: የበጎችህን መልክ አስተውለህ እወቅ፥ በከብቶችህም ላይ ልብህን አኑር፤

verses.en: For riches are not for ever: and doth the crown endure to every generation?
verses.am: ባለጠግነት ለዘላለም አይኖርምና፥ ዘውድም ለትውልድ ሁሉ አይጸናምና።

verses.en: The hay appeareth, and the tender grass sheweth itself, and herbs of the mountains are gathered.
verses.am: ደረቅ ሣር በታጨደ ጊዜ፥ አዲስ ለምለም በታየ ጊዜ፥ ከተራራውም ቡቃያ በተሰበሰበ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: The lambs are for thy clothing, and the goats are the price of the field.
verses.am: በጎች ለልብስህ ፍየሎችም የእርሻ ዋጋ ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: And thou shalt have goats' milk enough for thy food, for the food of thy household, and for the maintenance for thy maidens.
verses.am: ለሲሳይህ ለቤተ ሰቦችህም ሲሳይ ለገረዶችህም ምግብ የፍየል ወተት ይበቃል።

verses.en: The wicked flee when no man pursueth: but the righteous are bold as a lion.
verses.am: ኀጥእ ማንም ሳያሳድደው ይሸሻል፤ ጻድቅ ግን እንደ አንበሳ ያለ ፍርሃት ይኖራል።

verses.en: For the transgression of a land many are the princes thereof: but by a man of understanding and knowledge the state thereof shall be prolonged.
verses.am: ስለ አገሪቱ ዓመፀኝነት አለቆችዋ ብዙ ሆኑ፤ በአስተዋይና በአዋቂ ሰው ግን ዘመንዋ ይረዝማል።

verses.en: A poor man that oppresseth the poor is like a sweeping rain which leaveth no food.
verses.am: ድሆችን የሚያስጨንቅ ምስኪን ሰው እህልን እንደሚያጠፋ እንደ ዶፍ ዝናብ ነው።

verses.en: They that forsake the law praise the wicked: but such as keep the law contend with them.
verses.am: ሕግን የሚተዉ ሰዎች ኀጥኣንን ያመሰግናሉ፤ ሕግ ጠባቂዎች ግን ይጠሉአቸዋል።

verses.en: Evil men understand not judgment: but they that seek YAHUAH understand all things.
verses.am: ክፉዎች ሰዎች ፍርድን አያስተውሉም፤ እግዚአብሔርን የሚሹ ግን ሁሉን ያስተውላሉ።

verses.en: Better is the poor that walketh in his uprightness, than he that is perverse in his ways, though he be rich.
verses.am: በጠማማ መንገድ ከሚሄድ ባለጠጋ ያለ ነውር የሚሄድ ድሀ ይሻላል።

verses.en: Whoso keepeth the law is a wise son: but he that is a companion of riotous men shameth his father.
verses.am: ሕግን የሚጠብቅ አስተዋይ ልጅ ነው፤ ምናምንቴዎችን የሚከተል ግን አባቱን ያሳፍራል።

verses.en: He that by usury and unjust gain increaseth his substance, he shall gather it for him that will pity the poor.
verses.am: በአራጣ ብዛትና በቅሚያ ሀብቱን የሚያበዛ ለድሀ ለሚራራ ያከማችለታል።

verses.en: He that turneth away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer shall be abomination.
verses.am: ሕግን ከመስማት ጆሮውን የሚመልስ ጸሎቱ አስጸያፊ ናት።

verses.en: Whoso causeth the righteous to go astray in an evil way, he shall fall himself into his own pit: but the upright shall have good things in possession.
verses.am: ቅኖችን በክፉ መንገድ የሚያስት፥ እርሱ ወደ ጕድጓዱ ይወድቃል፤ ፍጹማን ግን መልካም ነገርን ይወርሳሉ።

verses.en: The rich man is wise in his own conceit; but the poor that hath understanding searcheth him out.
verses.am: ባለጠጋ ሰው ለራሱ ጠቢብ የሆነ ይመስለዋል፤ አስተዋይ ድሀ ግን ይመረምረዋል።

verses.en: When righteous men do rejoice, there is great glory: but when the wicked rise, a man is hidden.
verses.am: ጻድቃን ድል ባደረጉ ጊዜ ብዙ ክብር አለ፤ ኀጥኣን ከፍ ከፍ ባሉ ጊዜ ግን ሰው ይሸሸጋል።

verses.en: He that covereth his sins shall not prosper: but whoso confesseth and forsaketh them shall have mercy.
verses.am: ኃጢአቱን የሚሰውር አይለማም፤ የሚናዘዝባትና የሚተዋት ግን ምሕረትን ያገኛል።

verses.en: Happy is the man that feareth alway: but he that hardeneth his heart shall fall into mischief.
verses.am: ሁልጊዜ የሚፈራ ሰው ምስጉን ነው፤ ልቡን የሚያጸና ግን በክፉ ላይ ይወድቃል።

verses.en: As a roaring lion, and a ranging bear; so is a wicked ruler over the poor people.
verses.am: በድሀ ሕዝብ ላይ የሚገዛ ክፉ መኰንን እንደሚያገሣ አንበሳን እንደ ተራበ ድብ ነው።

verses.en: The prince that wanteth understanding is also a great oppressor: but he that hateth covetousness shall prolong his days.
verses.am: አእምሮ የጐደለው መኰንን ትልቅ ግፈኛ ነው፤ ግፍን የሚጠላ ግን ብዙ ዘመን ይኖራል።

verses.en: A man that doeth violence to the blood of any person shall flee to the pit; let no man stay him.
verses.am: የሰው ደም ያለበት ሰው እንደ ጕድጓድ ይሸሻል፥ ማንም አያስጠጋውም።

verses.en: Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved: but he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once.
verses.am: በቅንነት የሚሄድ ይድናል፤ በጠማምነት የሚሄድ ግን ወዲያው ይወድቃል።

verses.en: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread: but he that followeth after vain persons shall have poverty enough.
verses.am: ምድሩን የሚያርስ እንጀራ ይጠግባል፤ ምናምንቴዎችን የሚከተል ግን ድህነት ይሞላበታል።

verses.en: A faithful man shall abound with blessings: but he that maketh haste to be rich shall not be innocent.
verses.am: የታመነ ሰው እጅግ ይባረካል፤ ባለጠጋ ለመሆን የሚቸኵል ግን ሳይቀጣ አይቀርም።

verses.en: To have respect of persons is not good: for for a piece of bread that man will transgress.
verses.am: ማድላት፥ በቍራሽ እንጀራም መበደል መልካም አይደለም።

verses.en: He that hasteth to be rich hath an evil eye, and considereth not that poverty shall come upon him.
verses.am: ምቀኛ ሰው ባለጠጋ ለመሆን ይቸኵላል ችጋርም እንደሚመጣበት አያውቅም።

verses.en: He that rebuketh a man afterwards shall find more favour than he that flattereth with the tongue.
verses.am: ምላሱን ከሚያጣፍጥ ይልቅ ሰውን የሚገሥጽ በኋላ ሞገስ ያገኛል።

verses.en: Whoso robbeth his father or his mother, and saith, It is no transgression; the same is the companion of a destroyer.
verses.am: ከአባቱና ከእናቱ የሚሰርቅ። ኃጢአትን አልሠራሁም የሚልም የአጥፊ ባልንጀራ ነው።

verses.en: He that is of a proud heart stirreth up strife: but he that putteth his trust in YAHUAH shall be made fat.
verses.am: የሚጐመጅ ሰው ክርክርን ያነሣሣል፤ በእግዚአብሔር የሚታመን ግን ይጠግባል።

verses.en: He that trusteth in his own heart is a fool: but whoso walketh wisely, he shall be delivered.
verses.am: በገዛ ልቡ የሚታመን ሰው ሰነፍ ነው፤ በጥበብ የሚሄድ ግን ይድናል።

verses.en: He that giveth unto the poor shall not lack: but he that hideth his eyes shall have many a curse.
verses.am: ለድሀ የሚሰጥ አያጣም፤ ዓይኖቹን የሚጨፍን ግን እጅግ ይረገማል።

verses.en: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves: but when they perish, the righteous increase.
verses.am: ኀጥአን በተነሡ ጊዜ ሰዎች ይሸሸጋሉ፤ እነርሱ በጠፉ ጊዜ ግን ጻድቃን ይበዛሉ።

verses.en: He, that being often reproved hardeneth his neck, shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.
verses.am: ብዙ ጊዜ ተዘልፎ አንገቱን ያደነደነ ድንገት ይሰበራል፥ ፈውስም የለውም።

verses.en: When the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice: but when the wicked beareth rule, the people mourn.
verses.am: ጻድቃን በበዙ ጊዜ ሕዝብ ደስ ይለዋል፤ ኀጥኣን በሠለጠኑ ጊዜ ግን ሕዝብ ያለቅሳል።

verses.en: Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father: but he that keepeth company with harlots spendeth his substance.
verses.am: ጥበብን የወደደ ሰው አባቱን ደስ ያሰኛል፤ ጋለሞቶችን የሚከተል ግን ሀብቱን ያጠፋል።

verses.en: The king by judgment establisheth the land: but he that receiveth gifts overthroweth it.
verses.am: ንጉሥ በፍርድ አገሩን ያጸናል፤ መማለጃ የሚወድድ ግን ያፈርሰዋል።

verses.en: A man that flattereth his neighbour spreadeth a net for his feet.
verses.am: ወዳጁን በለዘበ ቃል የሚናገር ሰው ለእግሩ መርበብን ይዘረጋል።

verses.en: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare: but the righteous doth sing and rejoice.
verses.am: በክፉ ሰው ዓመፃ ወጥመድ ይገኛል፤ ጻድቅ ግን ደስ ይለዋል፥ እልልም ይላል።

verses.en: The righteous considereth the cause of the poor: but the wicked regardeth not to know it.
verses.am: ጻድቅ የድሆችን ፍርድ ይመለከታል፤ ኀጥእ ግን እውቀትን አያስተውልም።

verses.en: Scornful men bring a city into a snare: but wise men turn away wrath.
verses.am: ፌዘኞች ከተማቸውን ያቃጥላሉ፤ ጠቢባን ግን ቍጣን ይመልሳሉ።

verses.en: If a wise man contendeth with a foolish man, whether he rage or laugh, there is no rest.
verses.am: ጠቢብ ከሰነፍ ጋር ቢጣላ፥ ሰነፍ ወይም ይቈጣል ወይም ይስቃል፥ ዕረፍትም የለም።

verses.en: The bloodthirsty hate the upright: but the just seek his soul.
verses.am: ደምን ለማፍሰስ የሚሹ ሰዎች ፍጹሙን ሰው ይጠላሉ፥ ደግሞም የቅኑን ሰው ነፍስ ይሻሉ።

verses.en: A fool uttereth all his mind: but a wise man keepeth it in till afterwards.
verses.am: ሰነፍ ሰው ቍጣውን ሁሉ ያወጣል፤ ጠቢብ ግን በውስጡ ያስቀረዋል።

verses.en: If a ruler hearken to lies, all his servants are wicked.
verses.am: መኰንን ሐሰተኛ ነገርን ቢያደምጥ፥ ከእርሱ በታች ያሉት ሁሉ ዓመፅኞች ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: The poor and the deceitful man meet together: YAHUAH lighteneth both their eyes.
verses.am: ድሀና ግፈኛ ተገናኙ፤ እግዚአብሔር የሁለቱንም ዓይን ያበራል።

verses.en: The king that faithfully judgeth the poor, his throne shall be established for ever.
verses.am: ለድሀ በእውነት የሚፈርድ ንጉሥ፥ ዙፋኑ ለዘላለም ይጸናል።

verses.en: The rod and reproof give wisdom: but a child left to himself bringeth his mother to shame.
verses.am: በትርና ተግሣጽ ጥበብን ይሰጣሉ፤ ያልተቀጣ ብላቴና ግን እናቱን ያሳፍራል።

verses.en: When the wicked are multiplied, transgression increaseth: but the righteous shall see their fall.
verses.am: ኀጥኣን ሲበዙ ኃጢአት ትበዛለች፤ ጻድቃን ግን ውደቀታቸውን ያያሉ።

verses.en: Correct thy son, and he shall give thee rest; yea, he shall give delight unto thy soul.
verses.am: ልጅህን ቅጣ ዕረፍትንም ይሰጥሃል፤ ለነፍስህም ተድላን ይሰጣታል።

verses.en: Where there is no vision, the people perish: but he that keepeth the law, happy is he.
verses.am: ራእይ ባይኖር ሕዝብ መረን ይሆናል፤ ሕግን የሚጠብቅ ግን የተመሰገነ ነው።

verses.en: A servant will not be corrected by words: for though he understand he will not answer.
verses.am: ባሪያ በቃል አይገሠጽም፤ ቢያስተውል እንኳ አይመልስምና።

verses.en: Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words? there is more hope of a fool than of him.
verses.am: በቃሉ የሚቸኵለውን ሰው ብታይ፥ ከእርሱ ይልቅ ለሰነፍ ተስፋ አለው።

verses.en: He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child shall have him become his son at the length.
verses.am: ባሪያውን ከሕፃንነቱ ጀምሮ በማቀማጠል የሚያሳድግ የኋላ ኋላ እንደ ጌታ ያደርገዋል።

verses.en: An angry man stirreth up strife, and a furious man aboundeth in transgression.
verses.am: ቍጡ ሰው ክርክርን ያነሣሣል። ወፈፍተኛ ሰውም ኃጢአትን ያበዛል።

verses.en: A man's pride shall bring him low: but honour shall uphold the humble in spirit.
verses.am: ሰውን ትዕቢቱ ያዋርደዋል፤ መንፈሱን የሚያዋርድ ግን ክብርን ይቀበላል።

verses.en: Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul: he heareth cursing, and bewrayeth it not.
verses.am: ከሌባ ጋር የሚካፈል ነፍሱን ይጠላል፤ መርገምን ይሰማል፥ ነገር ግን ምንም አይገልጥም።

verses.en: The fear of man bringeth a snare: but whoso putteth his trust in YAHUAH shall be safe.
verses.am: ሰውን መፍራት ወጥመድ ያመጣል፤ በእግዚአብሔር የሚታመን ግን እርሱ ይጠበቃል።

verses.en: Many seek the ruler's favour; but every man's judgment cometh from YAHUAH.
verses.am: ብዙ ሰዎች የሹምን ፊት ይሻሉ፤ የሰው ፍርድ ግን ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነው።

verses.en: An unjust man is an abomination to the just: and he that is upright in the way is abomination to the wicked.
verses.am: ኃጢአተኛ በጻድቃን ዘንድ አስጸያፊ ነው፤ በቀና መንገድ የሚሄደውም በኀጥኣን ዘንድ አስጸያፊ ነው።

verses.en: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, even the prophecy: the man spake unto Ithiel, even unto Ithiel and Ucal,
verses.am: የማሣ አገር ሰው የያቄ ልጅ የአጉር ቃል ሰውየው ለኢቲኤልና ለኡካል እንደዚህ ይናገራል።

verses.en: Surely I am more brutish than any man, and have not the understanding of a man.
verses.am: እኔ በእውነት ከሰው ሁሉ ይልቅ ደንቆሮ ነኝ፥ የሰውም ማስተዋል የለብኛም።

verses.en: I neither learned wisdom, nor have the knowledge of the holy.
verses.am: ጥበብንም አልተማርሁም፥ ቅዱሱንም አላወቅሁትም።

verses.en: Who hath ascended up into heaven, or descended? who hath gathered the wind in his fists? who hath bound the waters in a garment? who hath established all the ends of the earth? what is his name, and what is his son's name, if thou canst tell?
verses.am: ወደ ሰማይ የወጣ የወረደስ ማን ነው? ነፋስንስ በእጁ የጨበጠ ማን ነው? ውኃንስ በልብሱ የቋጠረ ማን ነው? የምድርን ዳርቻ ሁሉ ያጸና ማን ነው? ይህን ታውቅ እንደ ሆንህ፥ ስሙ ማን የልጁስ ስም ማን ነው?

verses.en: Every word of YAHUAH is pure: he is a shield unto them that put their trust in him.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ሁሉ ተፈትናለች፤ እርሱ ለሚታመኑት ጋሻ ነው።

verses.en: Add thou not unto his words, lest he reprove thee, and thou be found a liar.
verses.am: እንዳይዘልፍህ፥ ሐሰተኛም እንዳትሆን በቃሉ አንዳች አትጨምር።

verses.en: Two things have I required of thee; deny me them not before I die:
verses.am: ሁለትን ነገር ከአንተ እሻለሁ፥ ሳልሞትም አትከልክለኝ፤

verses.en: Remove far from me vanity and lies: give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with food convenient for me:
verses.am: ከንቱነትንና ሐሰተኛነትን ከእኔ አርቃቸው፤ ድኅነትንና ባለጠግነትን አትስጠኝ፤ ነገር ግን የሚያስፈልገኝን እንጀራ ስጠኝ፥

verses.en: Lest I be full, and deny thee, and say, Who is YAHUAH? or lest I be poor, and steal, and take the name of my YAHUAH in vain.
verses.am: እንዳልጠግብ እንዳልክድህም። እግዚአብሔርስ ማን ነው? እንዳልል፤ ድሀም እንዳልሆን እንዳልሰርቅም፥ በአምላኬም ስም በሐሰት እንዳልምል።

verses.en: Accuse not a servant unto his master, lest he curse thee, and thou be found guilty.
verses.am: እንዳይሰድብህ በደለኛም እንዳትሆን ባሪያን በጌታው ፊት አትማ።

verses.en: There is a generation that curseth their father, and doth not bless their mother.
verses.am: አባቱን የሚረግም፥ እናቱንም የማይባርክ ትውልድ አለ።

verses.en: There is a generation that are pure in their own eyes, and yet is not washed from their filthiness.
verses.am: ለራሱ ንጹሕ የሆነ የሚመስለው ከርኵሰቱ ያልጠራ ትውልድ አለ።

verses.en: There is a generation, O how lofty are their eyes! and their eyelids are lifted up.
verses.am: ከፍ ከፍ ያሉ ዓይኖች ያሉት፥ ሽፋሽፍቶቹም ወደ ላይ የሚያዩ ትውልድ አለ።

verses.en: There is a generation, whose teeth are as swords, and their jaw teeth as knives, to devour the poor from off the earth, and the needy from among men.
verses.am: ድሆችን ከምድር ላይ ችግረኞችንም ከሰው መካከል ያጠፋና ይጨርስ ዘንድ ጥርሶቹ ሰይፍ መንጋጎቹም ካራ የሆኑ ትውልድ አለ።

verses.en: The horseleach hath two daughters, crying, Give, give. There are three things that are never satisfied, yea, four things say not, It is enough:
verses.am: አልቅት። ስጠን ስጠን የሚሉ ሁለት ሴቶች ልጆች አሉት። ሦስቱ የማይጠግቡ አራቱም። በቃን የማይሉ ናቸው፤

verses.en: The grave; and the barren womb; the earth that is not filled with water; and the fire that saith not, It is enough.
verses.am: እነርሱም ሲኦልና የማትወልድ ማኅፀን ውኃ የማትጠግብ ምድርና። በቃኝ የማትል እሳት ናቸው።

verses.en: The eye that mocketh at his father, and despiseth to obey his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, and the young eagles shall eat it.
verses.am: በአባትዋ የምታላግጥን የእናትዋንም ትእዛዝ የምትንቅን ዓይን የሸለቆ ቍራዎች ይጐጠጕጡአታል፥ አሞራዎችም ይበሉአታል።

verses.en: There be three things which are too wonderful for me, yea, four which I know not:
verses.am: ሦስት ነገር ይገርመኛል፥ አራተኛውንም ከቶ አላስተውለውም።

verses.en: The way of an eagle in the air; the way of a serpent upon a rock; the way of a ship in the midst of the sea; and the way of a man with a maid.
verses.am: እነርሱም የንስር መንገድ በሰማይ፥ የእባብ መንገድ በድንጋይ ላይ፥ የመርከብ መንገድ በባሕር ላይ፥ የሰውም መንገድ ከቈንጆ ጋር ናቸው።

verses.en: Such is the way of an adulterous woman; she eateth, and wipeth her mouth, and saith, I have done no wickedness.
verses.am: እንዲሁ በልታ አፍዋን የምታብስ። አንዳች ክፉ ነገር አላደረግሁም የምትልም የአመንዝራ ሴት መንገድ ናት።

verses.en: For three things the earth is disquieted, and for four which it cannot bear:
verses.am: በሦስት ነገር ምድር ትናወጣለች፥ አራተኛውንም ትሸከም ዘንድ አይቻላትም።

verses.en: For a servant when he reigneth; and a fool when he is filled with meat;
verses.am: ባሪያ በነገሠ ጊዜ ሰነፍም እንጀራ በጠገበ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: For an odious woman when she is married; and an handmaid that is heir to her mistress.
verses.am: የተጠላች ሴት ባል ባገኘች ጊዜ፥ ሴት ባሪያም እመቤቷን በወረሰች ጊዜ።

verses.en: There be four things which are little upon the earth, but they are exceeding wise:
verses.am: በምድር ላይ አራት ጥቃቅን ፍጥረቶች አሉ፤ እነርሱ ግን እጅግ ጠቢባን ናቸው፤

verses.en: The ants are a people not strong, yet they prepare their meat in the summer;
verses.am: ገብረ ጕንዳን ኃይል የሌላቸው ሕዝቦች ናቸው፥ ነገር ግን በበጋ መኖዋቸዋን ይሰበስባሉ።

verses.en: The conies are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks;
verses.am: ሽኮኮዎች ያልበረቱ ሕዝቦች ናቸው፥ ቤታቸውን ግን በቋጥኝ ድንጋይ ውስጥ ያደርጋሉ።

verses.en: The locusts have no king, yet go they forth all of them by bands;
verses.am: አንበጣዎች ንጉሥ የላቸውም፥ ሁላቸው ግን በመልካም ሥርዓት ይሄዳሉ።

verses.en: The spider taketh hold with her hands, and is in kings' palaces.
verses.am: እንሽላሊት በእጅ ይያዛል፥ በነገሥታት ግቢ ግን ይኖራል።

verses.en: There be three things which go well, yea, four are comely in going:
verses.am: መልካም አረማመድን የሚራመዱ ሦስት ፍጥረቶች አሉ፥ አራተኛውም መልካም አካሄድን ይሄዳል፤

verses.en: A lion which is strongest among beasts, and turneth not away for any;
verses.am: የአንበሳ ደቦል ከእንስሳ ሁሉ የሚበረታ፥ የማይመለስ፥ እንስሳንም የማይፈራ፤

verses.en: A greyhound; an he goat also; and a king, against whom there is no rising up.
verses.am: በእንስቶች መካከል በድፍረት የሚራመድ አውራ ዶሮ፤ መንጋን የምመራ አውራ ፍየል፤ በሕዝብ ፊት በግልጥ የሚናገር ንጉሥ።

verses.en: If thou hast done foolishly in lifting up thyself, or if thou hast thought evil, lay thine hand upon thy mouth.
verses.am: ከፍ ከፍ ስትል ስንፍናን ያደረግህ እንደሆነ፥ ክፉም ያሰብህ እንደ ሆነ፥ እጅህን በአፍህ ላይ ጫን።

verses.en: Surely the churning of milk bringeth forth butter, and the wringing of the nose bringeth forth blood: so the forcing of wrath bringeth forth strife.
verses.am: ወተት መግፋት ቅቤን ያወጣል፥ አፍንጫንም መጭመቅ ደምን ያወጣ፤ እንዲሁም ቍጣን መጐተት ጠብን ያወጣል።

verses.en: The words of king Lemuel, the prophecy that his mother taught him.
verses.am: እናቱ እርሱን ያስተማረችበት የማሣ ንጉሥ የልሙኤል ቃል።

verses.en: What, my son? and what, the son of my womb? and what, the son of my vows?
verses.am: ልጄ ሆይ፥ ምንድር ነው? የሆዴ ልጅ ሆይ፥ ምንድር ነው? የስእለቴ ልጅ ሆይ፥ ምንድር ነው?

verses.en: Give not thy strength unto women, nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings.
verses.am: ጕልበትህን ለሴቶች አትስጥ፥ መንገድህንም ነገሥታትን ለሚያጠፉ።

verses.en: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes strong drink:
verses.am: ለነገሥታት አይገባም፥ ልሙኤል ሆይ፥ ነገሥታት የወይን ጠጅ ይጠጡ ዘንድ አይገባም። መሳፍንትም። ብርቱ መጠጥ ወዴት ነው? ይሉ ዘንድ፤

verses.en: Lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted.
verses.am: እንዳይጠጡና ሕግን እንዳይረሱ፥ የድሀ ልጆችንም ፍርድ እንዳያጐድሉ።

verses.en: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, and wine unto those that be of heavy hearts.
verses.am: ለጥፋት ለቀረበው ሰው ብርቱ መጠጥ ስጡት፥ ነፍሱ ለመረረውም የወይን ጠጅ ስጡት፤

verses.en: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.
verses.am: ይጠጣ ድህነቱንም ይርሳ፥ ጕስቍልናውንም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አያስብ።

verses.en: Open thy mouth for the dumb in the cause of all such as are appointed to destruction.
verses.am: አፍህን ስለ ዲዳው ክፈት፥ ተስፋ ስለሌላቸውም ሁሉ ተፋረድ።

verses.en: Open thy mouth, judge righteously, and plead the cause of the poor and needy.
verses.am: አፍህን ክፍት፥ በእውነትም ፍረድ፤ ለድሀና ለምስኪን ፍረድ።

verses.en: Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies.
verses.am: ልባም ሴትን ማን ሊያገኛት ይችላል? ዋጋዋ ከቀይ ዕንቍ እጅግ ይበልጣል።

verses.en: The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her, so that he shall have no need of spoil.
verses.am: የባልዋ ልብ ይታመንባታል። ምርኮም አይጐድልበትም።

verses.en: She will do him good and not evil all the days of her life.
verses.am: ዕድሜዋን ሙሉ መልካም ታደርግለታለች፥ ክፉም አታደርግም።

verses.en: She seeketh wool, and flax, and worketh willingly with her hands.
verses.am: የበግ ጠጕርና የተልባ እግር ትፈልጋለች፥ በእጆችዋም ደስ ብሎአት ትሠራለች።

verses.en: She is like the merchants' ships; she bringeth her food from afar.
verses.am: እርስዋ እንደ ነጋዴ መርከብ ናት፤ ከሩቅ አገር ምግብዋን ትሰበስባለች።

verses.en: She riseth also while it is yet night, and giveth meat to her household, and a portion to her maidens.
verses.am: ገና ሌሊት ሳለ ትነሣለች ለቤትዋም ሰዎች ምግባቸውን፥ ለገረዶችዋም ተግባራቸውን ትሰጣለች።

verses.en: She considereth a field, and buyeth it: with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard.
verses.am: እርሻንም ተመልክታ ትገዛለች፤ ከእጅዋም ፍሬ ወይን ትተክላለች።

verses.en: She girdeth her loins with strength, and strengtheneth her arms.
verses.am: ወገብዋን በኃይል ትታጠቃለች፥ ክንድዋንም ታበረታለች።

verses.en: She perceiveth that her merchandise is good: her candle goeth not out by night.
verses.am: ንግድዋ መልካም እንደ ሆነ ትመለከታለች፤ መብራትዋ በሌሊት አይጠፋም።

verses.en: She layeth her hands to the spindle, and her hands hold the distaff.
verses.am: እጅዋን ወደ አመልማሎ ትዘረጋለች፥ ጣቶችዋም እንዝርትን ይይዛሉ።

verses.en: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor; yea, she reacheth forth her hands to the needy.
verses.am: እጅዋን ወደ ድሀ ትዘረጋለች፥ ወደ ችግረኛም እጅዋን ትሰድዳለች።

verses.en: She is not afraid of the snow for her household: for all her household are clothed with scarlet.
verses.am: ለቤትዋ ሰዎች ከበረዶ ብርድ የተነሣ አትፈራም፥ የቤትዋ ሰዎች ሁሉ እጥፍ ድርብ የለበሱ ናቸውና።

verses.en: She maketh herself coverings of tapestry; her clothing is silk and purple.
verses.am: ለራስዋም ግብረ መርፌ ስጋጃ ትሠራለች ጥሩ በፍታና ቀይ ግምጃ ትለብሳለች።

verses.en: Her husband is known in the gates, when he sitteth among the elders of the land.
verses.am: ባልዋ በአገር ሽማግሌዎች መካከል በሸንጎ በተቀመጠ ጊዜ በበር የታወቀ ይሆናል።

verses.en: She maketh fine linen, and selleth it; and delivereth girdles unto the merchant.
verses.am: የበፍታ ቀሚስ እየሠራች ትሸጣለች፥ ለነጋዴም ድግ ትሸጣለች።

verses.en: Strength and honour are her clothing; and she shall rejoice in time to come.
verses.am: ብርታትና ከበሬታ ልብስዋ ነው፤ በኋላም ዘመን ላይ ትስቃለች።

verses.en: She openeth her mouth with wisdom; and in her tongue is the law of kindness.
verses.am: አፍዋን በጥበብ ትከፍታለች፤ የርኅራኄም ሕግ በምላስዋ አለ።

verses.en: She looketh well to the ways of her household, and eateth not the bread of idleness.
verses.am: የቤትዋንም ሰዎች አካሄድ በደኅና ትመለከታለች፥ የሀኬትንም እንጀራ አትበላም።

verses.en: Her children arise up, and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praiseth her.
verses.am: ልጆችዋ ይነሣሉ፥ ምስጋናዋንም ይናገራሉ፤ ባልዋ ደግሞ እንዲህ ብሎ ያመሰግናታል።

verses.en: Many daughters have done virtuously, but thou excellest them all.
verses.am: መልካም ያደረጉ ብዙ ሴቶች አሉ፥ አንቺ ግን ከሁሉ ትበልጫለሽ።

verses.en: Favour is deceitful, and beauty is vain: but a woman that feareth YAHUAH, she shall be praised.
verses.am: ውበት ሐሰት ነው፥ ደም ግባትም ከንቱ ነው፤ እግዚአብሔርን የምትፈራ ሴት ግን እርስዋ ትመሰገናለች።

verses.en: Give her of the fruit of her hands; and let her own works praise her in the gates.
verses.am: ከእጅዋ ፍሬ ስጡአት፥ ሥራዎችዋም በሸንጎ ያመስግኑአት።
